summary.goal: Thin wrapper around agent-trajectories library shared by all persistent services in the server process.

acceptance_criteria.description: Service initializes FileStorage with .trajectories/ base directory
startTrajectory() creates trajectory with source metadata and initial chapter
record() adds events (tool_call, finding, note, error types)
recordDecisionEvent() adds structured decisions with alternatives
findBySource() retrieves trajectory by source.system + source.id
All functions gracefully no-op if storage not initialized

observations: Single FileStorage instance for the process - avoid multiple writers
Immutable update pattern - functions return new trajectory object
Low-frequency writes (~20-30 per session) - FileStorage JSON rewrite is acceptable
